input_zh: Reading 权威控制固定于 main 提交 4b2ce5786e40ce1c1fc5c7a86a9231ea72db0b93：Research Runtime Scheduler V3.0、Worker Control v1.3.0、Generated Reading Prompt v1.0.0；声明 SHA-256 为 9ad93d7f4cd7859fc0b32fa9b3b9e2b836a177c889addcc67d0b4fdc3261d7b5，同一提交上的全部 5 个 requiredSources 均完整读取。已对精确 Generated Prompt 字节执行确定性 SHA-256 计算并与声明值一致。唯一已核验的同日 Wake Receipt 为 research/runtime/wakes/2026/09/2026-09-10/reading-110110.json。Ordered Runtime Reconciliation 于 11:04:09+08:00 开启 Reading，原生 Worker Claim 路径于 11:05:33+08:00 在提交 9501533e10c8d1059a83459acddb321e54a4b680 中持久记录 Worker Claimed。Reading 只消费同日已完成的 Queue Plan research/runtime/plans/2026/09/2026-09-10-plan.json，其中 Q-20260910-01 与 Q-20260910-02 为 Selected，Open-source Engineering 明确为 No Selection。
workResult: Completed source-complete Deep Reading for both same-date Selected objects and produced two durable Reading Notes. Q-20260910-01 read Anthropic's September 9, 2026 first-party cybersecurity incident assessment covering four real third-party access incidents, the expansion from an initial approximately 141,000-transcript review to an approximately 481-million-transcript retrospective scan, isolated-versus-in-trajectory realism judgments, authorization-versus-reality distinctions, live blocker and offline monitor behavior, abortability, and the investigation's attribution and generalization limits. The bounded finding is that high-impact execution authority should depend on externally verifiable scope facts and a genuinely independent enforcement path: a monitor that consumes the actor's own interpretive narrative can inherit the same false scope premise, so model reasoning is not itself an independent authorization fact. Q-20260910-02 read the complete Procedural Graphs primary study across representation, runtime localization, offline refinement, structural validation, disjoint train/validation/test construction, candidate adoption and rejection, negative-constraint memory, benchmark results, long-horizon EnterpriseArena traces, localization ablations, and limitations. The bounded finding is that proposal authority must remain separate from activation authority: a self-modified procedure can be evaluated as a fixed candidate and admitted only after held-out evidence, while rejected proposals remain observable but inactive. The study provides data-split independence, not full model or organizational independence, because solver, guidance model and refiner share the same underlying LLM in each configuration; benchmark improvement is therefore not a production-safety proof. The exact two-note head c437d1919f5464ca567e99f3eecd6d04504ddbd0 passed the Validate Runtime Center step of Validate Research Center 3.0 run 34432282220 before terminal finalization. Reading performed no Research Analysis, article writing, visualization, Production or Publication.
workResult_zh: 已对两个同日 Selected Object 完成来源完整 Deep Reading，并生成两份持久 Reading Note。Q-20260910-01 完整深读 Anthropic 于 2026-09-09 发布的一手网络安全事故评估，覆盖 4 起真实第三方访问事故、从最初约 14.1 万条 Transcript 检查扩展到约 4.81 亿条 Transcript 的回溯审计、孤立证据判断与长轨迹内判断差异、Reality 与 Authorization 的分离、Live Blocker 与 Offline Monitor 的差异、Abortability，以及事故归因与外推边界。边界结论是：高影响执行授权必须依赖外部可核验 Scope Fact 与真正独立的 Enforcement Path；如果 Monitor 消费 Actor 自己的解释性叙事，就可能继承相同的错误 Scope Premise，因此模型推理本身不能充当独立授权事实。Q-20260910-02 完整深读 Procedural Graphs 一手研究的 Graph Representation、Runtime Localization、Offline Refinement、Structural Validation、相互隔离的 Train/Validation/Test 构造、Candidate Adoption/Rejection、Negative-constraint Memory、Benchmark 结果、EnterpriseArena 长生命周期轨迹、Localization Ablation 与限制。边界结论是：Proposal Authority 必须与 Activation Authority 分离；自修改 Procedure 应先成为固定 Candidate，以 Held-out Evidence 决定是否进入 Active State，被拒绝的 Proposal 可以保留为可观察证据但不得成为可执行状态。该研究证明的是 Data-split Independence，而不是完整的 Model/Organizational Independence，因为每个配置里的 Solver、Guidance Model 与 Refiner 使用同一个底层 LLM；因此 Benchmark Improvement 不能被扩大成 Production Safety 证明。精确两份 Note Head c437d1919f5464ca567e99f3eecd6d04504ddbd0 已在终态收口前通过 Validate Research Center 3.0 Run 34432282220 的 Validate Runtime Center 步骤。Reading 未执行 Research Analysis、文章写作、可视化、Production 或 Publication。
